values.goal: Run the paid live GCP qualification deferred by #663 and prove the snapshot-backed two-node Runtime/Guardian plus L4 Ollama Polis works and cleans up within the authorized USD 20.00 budget.
values.required_outcome: A real GCP run in project cs-poc-cha8mmii0xk0iaw5vpf8mxf produces two sealed snapshots, restores and launches the two-node Polis, proves live private Ollama and real agent/tool behavior, records exact timing and cost, removes all issue-owned VMs and disks, and retains only the intended snapshots.
declared_scope: the merged #663 warm-polis preparation, snapshot-catalog, launch, and cleanup paths
one Runtime/Guardian node and one L4 Ollama node
live readiness, resident-model, real-agent/tool, timing, cost, and cleanup evidence
bounded repairs required to make the live qualification pass
authority_boundary: typed C-SDLC v2 remains lifecycle authority
operator authorization is limited to USD 20.00 of incremental GCP spend in the exact company project
the pre-existing #509 relay is not issue-owned and cannot be deleted or materially changed without necessity and explicit evidence
AWS and unrelated GCP resources remain out of scope
only the two intended generation snapshots may remain after cleanup
operator_constraints: use repo Terraform and real GCP resources
use command-scoped company credentials without exposing key contents
do not use synthetic timing or fixture-only functional proof
normal startup must not build, install, access Git, or download models
run a real agent/tool-path smoke and resolve every required failure
work only in the bound FastWork worktree
